negativeEvidenceReview.summary: No public GENIUS issuer intent, token-specific PPSI approval, state-qualified approval, or official application source was located for SBC as of 2026-06-18. Brale continues to operate under existing FinCEN MSB and state money transmitter licenses with no announced GENIUS pathway.
